## Phase 1 is active; T09 Retry 2 is at the pre-entry qualification gate

Phase 0.75 is complete. Phase 1 is open for sequential artifact-execution work, but
paid compute, prototype execution, benchmark execution, training, and cloud mutation
all remain disabled. The T07 one-step SiRA artifact smoke has been executed and
offline-adjudicated; both sessions were incomplete, no scientific measurement or
EXP-0001 outcome was assigned, and its execution authority is exhausted. The tracked
Historical `PLAN-EXP0001-PILOT-V3` remains unauthorized (`authorized: false`). Its one-launch
private authority was consumed by a preflight-only Lambda campaign, which stopped
before any model request, task browser action, condition, evaluator, or score because
the exact frozen T07 container image could not be materialized. The host was
terminated and zero T09 instances were verified. The current-turn-authorized V4
successor preserves every scientific lock, supersedes only historical image-digest
equality, and must qualify and freeze one exact replacement image before any task
model request or task browser action. EXP-0001 remains unevaluated.
:::

GIC Lab studies a narrower and more falsifiable question than “can we build a GIC agent?”:

> Which proposed mechanisms are necessary, sufficient, learnable, and measurably better than matched external orchestration?

The program begins with the authors' released SiRA and SR²AM references, then isolates one mechanism at a time under declared resource budgets. Negative and inconclusive evidence is a valid outcome.

## Phase 1 boundary

- Execute work packages sequentially and only under their exact current-turn human
  authorization; analysis tasks do not inherit execution authority.
- Keep the first smoke to one matched SiRA reactive/simulative pair and prohibit
  scientific interpretation.
- Preserve raw evidence, version/hash identity, budgets, attempts, and verified cleanup.
- Record the fixed SiRA mode as `experiment_assignment`, never learned regulation.
- Treat any planned/deferred RQ-H2K trace-sufficiency output as infrastructure evidence
  only; it adds no experiment, condition, training path, learned kernel, or later phase.
- Keep reusable tracked pilot authority, SR²AM cloud runs, and training disabled;
  T09 V3's consumed single-use overlay grants no replay authority; Retry 2 uses fresh
  V4/0002 identities and a separate private single-use overlay.
- Treat the T07 smoke's usage and trajectories only as artifact-execution evidence;
  they are neither pilot observations nor representative full-task costs.
